what: One free unit, two fights at once (the kill check of the spare tactic drill 'choose the fight that can still be turned'). Per battle four lanes; a lane holds TWO fights 180 m apart: in each an enemy Skaven unit attacks our Empire spearmen anvil at a run from 200 m at the go (the game teleports a unit's FRONT to the point, so the sides start 212-214 m apart), the anvil is never ordered; one free unit B (Empire swordsmen) stands on the anvils' line between them, 90 m from each. Fight kinds by the enemy unit: D doomed (stormvermin_1), E even (clanrats_1), W won (skavenslave_spearmen_0). Lanes ED_E, ED_D, EW_E, EW_W = the pair of fights, then the one B joins. B gets its attack order 8 s after the LATER of the two anvils' first melee flags. Morale is on for everyone. After-fight rule 'seek', the same for both sides: a unit standing with no live target is ordered to attack at a run the nearest standing enemy of its own lane; none - halt. A lane ends 480 s after contact, or after 30 consecutive quiet seconds with one whole side out, or at 600 s. trade = both enemy units' lost health share - our three units' lost share over [B's order, +120 s / +240 s / the lane's end]; a dead unit = all its health lost. Battle difficulty Normal, 16 battles (8 a mirror), lane kinds rotate over places. Code: game/probe/unit_probe.py --pick2, bridge/lua/entries/charge_probe.lua (commit 2542b27).
lines_written_before: worth a drill if in the GAME (B joins E) - (B joins D), trade at 240 s, pooled over mirrors, mean - 2SE >= +0.03; 'won' is a class of its own only if (B joins E) - (B joins W) mean - 2SE >= +0.03 by the same read
paired_why: [mean, SE = sd of the differences / sqrt(n), n], paired by battle (game) / by copy (twin). The twin is the simulator on the plan's own layout (unit_probe --pick2 layout, 32 copies), NOT on the recorded starts: the twin on the recorded starts was killed by memory (exit 137 at 8 GB) and was not rerun.

verdict.even against doomed: GO: E - D at 240 s +0.179, mean - 2SE +0.165 >= +0.03, positive in 16 of 16 battles; holds at 120 s (+0.072) and at the lane's end (+0.130). Joining the doomed fight costs B 0.62 of its health by 240 s and does not save the anvil (0.73 lost with B against 0.73 without).
verdict.even against won: PASSES THE LINE, NOT ROBUST: E - W at 240 s +0.047, mean - 2SE +0.031 >= +0.03 (15 of 16 battles), but the sign depends on the window: at 120 s -0.018 (the won fight is the better one to join), at the lane's end +0.007 +- 0.057 (no difference). A drill must not teach 'never join the won fight' on this evidence.
verdict.simulator: the layout twin agrees with the game in sign and roughly in size on both contrasts at 120 s and 240 s (see paired_twin_layout_2542b27).
